store.summary: GPS logger with IMU, waypoint photos, vehicle setup and profile
store.description: Logs GPS tracks to daily CSV files using the JP226 ESP32 logger's timing and unchanged 63-column telemetry schema. Reads the CardputerZero BMI270 IMU, captures camera photos for waypoints even without a GPS fix, and records road, surface, tyre pressure, suspension and load settings. A CAMERA page with live preview takes photos with GPS in their EXIF, a GALLERY page browses them, and an ENV page shows an M5 ENV unit and accessory probe temperatures. Works with the JP226 M5Dial and black box through an AtomS3 USB bridge. Converts each day's log to Google Earth KML and GPX every night, and a SHARE page starts a local Wi-Fi web page (or its own hotspot) for copying logs and photos to a phone. Stores a make/model/year vehicle profile for planned OBD-II readings; OBD connection and OBD logging are not implemented yet. Includes a two-dinosaur Dino Dash.
